=={{header|Ada}}==
Ada does not confuse types (classes) and modules. These are semantically different things. In the context of this task class means a dynamically polymorphic type supporting dynamic dispatch. In Ada such types are represented by tagged types:
<syntaxhighlight lang="Ada">
type Dispatching is tagged null record;
</syntaxhighlight>
Outer/inner is a question of where a type can be declared. The answer is practically anywhere.

Any type can be declared in the module where a tagged or any type is declared. Any type can be declared in the body implementing a tagged type or any type. Any type can be declared inside a subprogram, methods included.
